title: [Main][ALL-E] Posting a Sales Credit Memo with a different Unit of Measure does not convert the quantity before updating the originating Sales Order (Blanket Sales Order is updated correctly)
summary: Fixed a bug where posting a sales credit memo with a different unit of measure failed to convert the quantity before updating the originating sales order, causing incorrect deductions.
key_points: Credit memo quantities are now converted to the sales order line's unit of measure before updating shipped and invoiced quantities
Previously, 8 PCS was incorrectly deducted as 8 SET instead of 2 SET when units differed
Regression tests added for different, fractional, and matching units of measure scenarios
quote: Convert the credited base quantity using the sales order line's Qty. per Unit of Measure before updating quantities.
